system.name: DIP
system.one_liner: a dynamic, modality-aware pipeline scheduling framework for large multimodal model (LMM) training

components.name: LMM model
components.role: the large multimodal model to be partitioned before training

components.name: Model Chunk Partitioner
components.role: offline component that divides the LMM into model chunks based on the separated partitioning principle

components.name: Model chunks
components.role: the resulting statically-placed chunks distributed to designated GPUs

components.name: Training batches
components.role: input batches whose metadata is fetched at the start of each iteration

components.name: Sub-Microbatch Partitioner
components.role: divides microbatches into smaller, modality-specific sub-microbatches for load balancing

components.name: Pipeline Schedule Searcher
components.role: explores and searches candidate pipeline schedules for the current batch

components.name: Multimodal Training Simulator
components.role: simulates candidate schedules, used by both the partitioner and the searcher

components.name: GPU Training Workers
components.role: GPUs that execute the deployed pipeline schedule for the current iteration

content.key_idea: DIP separates an offline model-chunk partitioning phase from an online four-step planning loop (prefetch metadata, adaptive microbatch partitioning, schedule search, deploy) so that pipeline schedules can be tailored per-batch without stalling GPU training workers.
content.reading_order: Top box (Offline Partitioner) shows the LMM model being split into model chunks before training; bottom box (Online Planner) shows the circled ①-④ per-iteration loop from training batches through partitioning and schedule search to deployment on GPU Training Workers.

summary: This figure shows the overall workflow of DIP, a scheduling framework for large multimodal model training. In an offline Model Chunk Partitioner phase, the LMM model is divided into model chunks (shown as a stack of four pastel-colored rectangles) that are statically distributed to designated GPUs. During training, an Online Planner executes a four-step circled loop each iteration: (1) prefetch metadata for the next batch, (2) the Sub-Microbatch Partitioner splits microbatches into modality-specific sub-microbatches, (3) the Pipeline Schedule Searcher explores pipeline schedules (self-loop), both partitioner and searcher relying on a shared Multimodal Training Simulator, and (4) deploy the resulting schedule to the GPU Training Workers. Blue flat-filled boxes represent the core pipeline components, orange marks the ordered steps, and dashed borders group the offline and online phases.
summary_zh: 该图展示DIP的整体工作流：训练前，模型分块器(Model Chunk Partitioner)将LMM模型离线切分为模型块并静态分配到各GPU；训练期间，在线规划器每轮迭代执行四步循环（①预取元数据、②子微批分割器切分子微批、③流水线调度搜索器探索调度方案、④将调度部署到GPU训练worker），二者共用多模态训练模拟器。
